verdict.rationale: Docs and quickstart show page.ai() accepting natural-language goals (e.g., 'search for flights... select cheapest option') executed as multi-step browser agent tasks in cloud sessions, and the agents overview confirms AI-driven browser agents that navigate and act on single API calls. Runtime probe confirms the SDK/MCP server actually installs and runs, adding some independent corroboration. missing for 10: no independent hands-on report of a full complex multi-step flow (e.g., form fill + multi-page navigation) succeeding end-to-end, and community evidence focuses mostly on scraping/pricing rather than agentic task completion.
